heard: The Big Dipper stars are drifting apart, in opposite directions. We usually see this spoon as a permanent cosmic landmark. Astronomer Richard Proctor found a secret drifting family in 1869. Moroc, Fecta, Megrez, Aliath, and Mysar are stellar siblings. They're all traveling together toward the constellation Sagittarius. But the stars at the ends are total strangers. Doobie and Alcate are actually zooming the other way. This tug-of-war will bend the handle until the spoon dissolves in 100,000 years. The famous spoon is slowly breaking into pieces.
differences: 'merak phecda' heard as 'moroc fecta' after 'family in 1869'
